images.title: Ten numbers between 25 and 36
images.purpose: Shows a number line from 25 to 36 where the 10 whole numbers strictly between the two squares are marked.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One horizontal number line across the middle, with dots above its ticks and one bracket.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal number line with exactly 12 evenly spaced tick marks for the whole numbers 25 to 36; only the end ticks carry numerals, 25 at the left and 36 at the right, with 5² written under 25 and 6² under 36. A large teal (#0072B2) dot sits on each end tick. Exactly 10 smaller amber (#E69F00) dots sit on the ticks for 26 to 35. A dark bracket above the 10 amber dots is tagged 10 numbers. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Between n² and (n + 1)² there are exactly 2n whole numbers.
images.description: Shows a number line from 25 to 36 where the 10 whole numbers strictly between the two squares are marked.

image_decisions.why: Marking the gap on a number line makes the count between consecutive squares countable.
